Class HealInsightModels

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.doctor.history.HealInsightModels
public final class HealInsightModels extends Object
Heal insights for the Reporting canvas (S3-06 / issue #5972).

Counts HealingDecision statuses from persisted SHAFT Heal reports. Locator patch proposals are review-gated: only RECOVERED with a passing action outcome may offer a reviewable diff. AMBIGUOUS never gets an apply-to-source primary action. NO_CANDIDATES is shown, never silent. Failed replay never persists a proposal. Policy: locator-healing.md and issue #5454 remain controlling — never auto-land.
